sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation.
Our order history for this part shows 28.94 EUR (po:4500010017-10) against 29.89 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is 24.31 EUR (cost:340010).
Our volume forecast for this part is up 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,400 pcs per year over 36 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your data, but our pricing reflects current operational realities. As a matter of policy, we do not provide internal cost breakdowns. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We accept the 36-month term and 23,400 pieces, but your requested 42-day lead time requires a unit price of €33.40. Our offer stands for a price of €33.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

We note the delivery record data you provided; it has been verified but does not impact our pricing. 

In response to your revised proposal, we adjust our unit price to €33.30 per unit. The parameters of a volume of 23400 pcs per year over a contract term of 36 months with a Lieferzeit of 42 days remain unchanged. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
